data.body: Fix pushed as Gerrit change 3181 (commit 81172cf6171). Evidence: (1) Before: a scratch pytest plugin that SIGSTOPs the test process 0.1 s into the call phase and SIGCONTs it 4.5 s later failed the unmodified test 3 of 3 on py3.11.16 with 'assert cancelled' passing and 'assert elapsed < 4.5' failing at 4.63-4.66 s; the read-timeout probe failed the same way. (2) Code path: 200 in-suite samples (full unit tier on py3.11, -n 4 --dist worksteal) plus 50 under 40-48 bounded busy workers: cancel 0.300-0.303 s after tool start in every sample, run end at most 0.48 s, GC inside the run at most 0.003 s, no leftover tasks on the reused event loop. (3) After: same freeze, 3 of 3 pass; a 6 s freeze also passes. (4) Mutations: dropping tool_timeout=0.3 fails 'assert cancelled'; read=5 with the server releasing at 1 s fails the ReadTimeout assert; restored file passes. (5) py3.11 -n 4 3 of 3 pass; make lint exit 0 (wall-clock-asserts clean); make typecheck exit 0.
